hooks.name: spec-audit
hooks.description: After the agent writes a file, audits aegis-sentinel UI files (.tsx/.jsx/.css/.html, src/ui/**/*.ts) against .kiro/steering/ui-manifesto.md: gradients, blur/glass, soft shadows, rounded corners, Inter/system fonts, icon packs, eased motion, non-token colors. Violations are reported to the agent on stderr. PostToolUse runs on Web, IDE, and CLI.
